outline:
The course aims to provide an introduction to probability which is a useful and fundamental mathematical tool for EE students. The course contains the following topics:

1. Experiments, Models, and Probabilities
2. Discrete Random Variables
3. Continuous Random Variables
4. Pairs of Random Variables
5. Random Vectors
6. Sums of Random Variables

Week 01. Experiments, Models, and Probabilities, Compensatory holiday for Peace Memorial Day

Week 03. Experiments, Models, and Probabilities
Week 04. Discrete Random Variables
Week 05. Discrete Random Variables
Week 06. Discrete Random Variables, Compensatory holiday for Children's Day
Week 07. Discrete Random Variables
Week 08. Continuous Random Variables
Week 09. Continuous Random Variables, Midterm Exam
Week 10. Continuous Random Variables, Labor Day
Week 11. Continuous Random Variables
Week 12. Pairs of Random Variables
Week 13. Pairs of Random Variables
Week 14. Pairs of Random Variables
Week 15. Pairs of Random Variables
Week 16. Random Vectors
Week 17. Sums of Random Variables, Dragon Boat Festival
Week 18. Sums of Random Variables, Final Exam

The schedule may be adjusted if necessary.
